mechanism: Bupropion inhibits norepinephrine reuptake and tranylcypromine is an irreversible MAOI, creating risk of hypertensive crisis, seizures, and serotonergic toxicity through combined monoaminergic potentiation.
action: Contraindicated combination; do not use together; allow minimum 14 days washout after MAOI discontinuation before starting bupropion.
